title: Homecoming
note: Story order taken from the map script. Encounter lines (fights, side events) are placed where they usually happen; their exact order depends on the player's route.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: At attention, guardsmen. Prince Arthas has returned from Northrend! With any luck, he has brought home a cure for the plague.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then at least his little sailing trip will have been worth it. I don't see why we all have to fawn over his every action.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Lieutenant Bandarion, we swore an oath to serve the house of Menethil. Now let's prepare the city to welcome our prince home.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Of course, Captain Landen. I'd hate to disappoint the prince.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: You’re a better guardsman than you let on, Garek. You could make captain yourself if you took things seriously.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Are you that eager for me to replace you?

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Of course. I’d love to finally retire.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Showering the prince with flowers seems like a little much to me.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: This is an event that calls for celebration, Garek. The people deserve to rejoice.

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Is it true? Prince Arthas has finally returned? About time!

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Does anyone know why the prince sailed for Northrend at all? What could he possibly want up there?

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: I heard Prince Arthas disbanded the paladin order before he left. Why would he do that?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You'll have to move your cart ma'am, it's blocking the palace gates.

lines.speaker: Alicia
lines.text: But the wheel is beyond repair!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Don't worry, we'll find you a new one.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Gold well spent. We could just push the cart out of the prince’s way.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Then it would still be broken. Our job is to help people, not push them aside.

lines.speaker: Alicia
lines.text: Oh, thank you! Please take this token of gratitude.

lines.speaker: Eugene
lines.text: Stop! Thief!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: After him!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: I won’t let Prince Arthas return to a city riddled with crime.

lines.speaker: Luca
lines.text: I saw it! Prince Arthas purged Stratholme! He killed them all!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'd better check that out.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Move along!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: You can sober up at home or in a cell. Your choice.

lines.speaker: Luca
lines.text: I know what I saw!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Can you believe what he was saying?

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Baseless rumors. No one really knows what happened in Stratholme, but I’m sure Prince Arthas did all he could for his subjects.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Well, that was a hard day’s work. I’m sure our dear prince will appreciate it.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Sounds like Prince Arthas has arrived. Let’s report to our post.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: ... Garek.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No offense, Captain, but I didn't join the city guard to sweep the streets for the royal family.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I want to fight in defense of Lordaeron. I want the thrill of battle and the glory of victory.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek, I've fought enough wars to know that glory is a myth.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Survival is the real victory, and peace is its reward. Never lose sight of that.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: But wait... do you hear that?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What the hell was that?

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: I don't... Garek! Look out!

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: Begone spawn of darkness!

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: To arms!

lines.speaker: Assassin
lines.text: Get 'em!

lines.speaker: Blightweaver
lines.text: Our plans come to pass! Death claims you all!

lines.speaker: Necromancer
lines.text: Tremble before the Scourge!

lines.speaker: Blightweaver
lines.text: How long I have waited this day!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The door's locked!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We need another way in. Hurry!

lines.speaker: Arthas
lines.text: This kingdom shall fall, and from the ashes will arise a new order, that will shake the very foundations of the world!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: So the rumors were true... Prince Arthas has lost his mind!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: King Terenas! No!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The undead! Captain, we have to join the battle!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: What happened here?!

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: It--It was Prince Arthas, sir! He killed the king! His own father!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He’s in league with these monsters?!

lines.speaker: Lord Vileor
lines.text: At long last, the Cult of the Damned will lay waste to Lordaeron!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Is there no end to them? We need a way out of here!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Uther the Lightbringer!

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Guardsmen! Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No, sir...

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: But King Terenas...

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: My king...

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Lord Uther, what is happening out there?

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: The city is overrun with cultists and the undead. Arthas has betrayed us all!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I was too late to save Terenas, but I will bring his traitorous son to justice.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: The two of you rally the city guard and rescue as many civilians as possible.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: We regroup at Andorhal. Light guide you both.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain... what do we do?

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: There’s an old evacuation route through the sewers. Let’s hope it’s still intact.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Arthas! That traitor!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Leave him for Uther! We need to keep moving!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: By the Light...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This can't be happening... How could Arthas damn his own kingdom?!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We have to fight back! We have to drive out these monsters and reclaim our home!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek, listen to me. The city is lost, but it can be rebuilt. What matters is protecting its people.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I... I understand. Let's get to the sewers.

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Captain Landen! Lieutenant Bandarion!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: With us, guardsmen!

lines.speaker: Villager
lines.text: Thank the Light! There are more survivors trapped on the other side of the palace!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We’ll do our best to save them. Stay here while we clear a path!

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Guardsmen! We’ve got yer back!

lines.speaker: Necromancer
lines.text: None shall survive!

lines.speaker: Ghoul
lines.text: Must feed!

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Over here! We need help!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The area’s secure for now. Hold this position and wait for our signal!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Almost there! The evacuation route is just ahead!

lines.speaker: Fudge
lines.text: Rend and tear!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: That abomination stands between us and the sewers.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Not for long.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The way is clear! Gather the survivors!

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Captain Landen! We've secured the exit tunnels!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Well done, guardsmen! Everyone into the sewers!

lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Go with the survivors! We'll buy you some time!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: For Lordaeron.
